name: Chicken Rice Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup (120 ml) condensed cream of mushroom soup
3 hard boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
1 ½ teaspoon salt or less, to taste
2 cups (480 g) cooked chicken, cooled and chopped

steps: In the serving bowl, whisk or mix mayonnaise, yoghurt, cream of mushroom soup, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and dry mustard until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well using a spoon or fork.
Refrigerate for at least half an hour.
Top with a sprig of parsley and serve.
